text:
Alex P: Quick kickoff — publisher buildpack + legal checks for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Need a short checklist and owners so we can unblock publisher this week. @Laura L can you own legal artifacts?
Laura L: Yep, I can take legal. Need EULA, SOC2 pointer, and any custom contract terms from the publisher. Who's owning asset manifest?
Priya S: I can own product packaging & manifest. I'll pull the final buildpack (buildpack-v1.2.tar.gz) and create a preview bundle for each cloud.
Sam E: Heads up — runtime compatibility check found a cudnn mismatch for the GCP image. I'll spin a test instance and report back by EOD.
Miguel O: I'll handle sandbox tenant creds + IAM roles for publisher testing. Please list the required service accounts and KMS access.
Jenna M: Marketing needs hero image + 1-line blurb for the listing. Can we get a draft by Friday? Also, any co-marketing flags? :wave:
Alex P: Owners so far: Legal=Laura, Product/manifest=Priya, Runtime=Sam, Sandbox/Mgmt=Miguel, Marketing=Jenna. I'll coordinate the publisher communications.
Laura L: For legal checklist: 1) EULA pdf, 2) Contact for CLA/KMS terms, 3) Data residency statement, 4) Support SLAs. If publisher has custom terms, upload to /legal/inbound/publisher-name.
Priya S: Packaging checklist (short): - buildpack-v1.2.tar.gz - manifest.json (images, entrypoint, ports) - sample infra terraform snippet - trial entitlement flags (trial=true/false)
Priya S: sample manifest snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "redwood-publisher-buildpack",
  "version": "1.2",
  "containers": ["runtime:gpu-1"],
  "deploy": {"aws": "ami-xyz", "gcp": "image-abc", "azure": "vhd-123"}
}
```
Sam E: After I repro the cudnn issue, plan: build a small image with cudnn 8.2 and run a simple inference trace. If it fails, we fallback to pinned runtime on GCP.
Miguel O: Sandbox deliverables list: - test tenant created - IAM role: publisher-listing-test - KMS key provisioned (alias/dev-pub-key) - credentials posted to 1Password/shared vault
Alex P: Timeline proposal: Today — owners ack + initial asks. Wed — legal draft and manifest preview. Thu — runtime smoke tests. Fri — final assets to marketplace portal. Sound realistic?
Laura L: Acked. Laura will need publisher NDA signed to share some contract clauses.
Jenna M: I'll draft hero blurb options: 1) "High-throughput LLM inference for product teams" 2) "Predictable latency and cost for serving LLMs". Will share in #marketing for quick feedback.
Priya S: Quick question — do we want to enable the auto-scaling policy by default in the manifest? That changes pricing visibility.
Alex P: Let's default to conservative autoscale (min=1, max=4) and note it in the pricing metadata. We can iterate after listing.
Sam E: Update: reproduced cudnn mismatch on GCP; workaround is to pin to runtime image runtime-gpu-cuda11-cudnn8.6. Uploading patch now.
Miguel O: Sandbox tenant ready. Posted creds to 1Password under "partnerships/publisher-x/sandbox".
onboard-bot: Reminder: please attach final listing artifacts to the publisher portal before 1876543330 or the staging slot will be released.
Alex P: Thanks all — I'll send a consolidated checklist and close this thread once artifacts are uploaded. :thumbsup:
